direct_facts: The exact-coverage inventory found zero complete nonblank lines identical to another line or schema string in either real stage. This rules out a nonempty whole-line exact-identity-only intervention on this fixture, not semantic compression generally.

Middle producer attempt 1 returned 50 relations. Fourteen fail provenance validation individually: ten invalid/self description references and four blank source strings. One cited index is 58 for a description with only 57 lines.
The single permitted structural repair again returned 50 relations with the same 14-error count. Both attempts completed with finish_reason stop; neither was truncated.
Late producer returned an empty relation array on its first attempt. It compiled to an unchanged candidate with zero characters removed, below the frozen 500-character feasibility threshold.
No independent missing-claim checker request was made: the Middle graph was rejected before that stage, and the Late graph was empty. No actor, judge or native tool calls were made.
Three updater requests settled, USD 0.004218228, no new unknown charge or transport retry. The backup key was not activated.
observations_and_limits: The relation interface elicited nonempty output for Middle unlike the prior direct-edit generator, but this is neither a quality gain nor a causal comparison: prompts, representation and compiler changed together.

Thirty-six individually structurally valid relations per Middle attempt have not been accepted semantically. They are not salvaged, relabeled as a candidate, or sent for extra model review after the frozen whole-output failure.
The independent semantic veto and its effect on deletion safety remain empirically untested. The result does not show that verification is ineffective.

The repeated invalid references directly demonstrate failed evidence localization. Whether explicit source identifiers or deterministic pair construction would solve it is a new, untested intervention.
The cause of the Late empty response remains unknown. Fixing Middle references alone would not establish that both stages can form a useful patch.

The producer input exposes description_lines as an implicitly indexed array, and the repair feedback reports a generic invalid-reference error rather than the offending relation. The observations do not separate model indexing difficulty from this interface/feedback design. Explicit identifiers or host-constructed pairs are implementation changes to test, not evidence that the model cannot judge coverage.

verification.tests: 47 passed: 13 new coverage compilation tests, 10 prior deletion tests and 24 selective tests; first 13 failed on unimplemented functions before implementation
verification.freeze_integrity: 23 source/input/config files verified before calls and offline evaluation
verification.upstream_whitespace: Git diff check reported whitespace already present in the pinned author source copies. Those bytes were retained to preserve source hashes; project-owned files had no whitespace findings.

next_decision.close: Do not rerun this producer, increase repair count, or lower the feasibility/semantic/original-performance gates.
next_decision.worth_examining: A deterministic constructor could enumerate valid claim/evidence pairs, leaving only gap adjudication to the fixed LLM. This changes responsibility for locating evidence and makes the untested checker reachable without model-invented offsets. First check whether task-free real metadata supplies enough meaningful candidate coverage under a predeclared rule; do not handpick relations from these failed outputs.
next_decision.not_required: No user approval, web billing login or positive actor example is a prerequisite for a legal metadata-only mechanism test.
